purpose: Adapt the existing RGB observer to opposite camera views using new paired procedural data. The stopped frozen-camera test remains unchanged and its seed is excluded. Preserve the demo and all earlier evidence.
data_method: The original bounded static observer sampler and segmentation/visible-keypoint labels, with the declared fixed camera angles. Each split uses the same sampled qpos and lights for the original/opposite camera pair. New image archives stay local; exact sampled states, source recipes and inputs are retained for compact reproduction.

training.optimizer: AdamW with 0.0001 weight decay and cosine schedule
training.selection: After all 6000 steps complete within budget, select the eligible opposite-camera candidate with most accepted present development states, then lowest accepted p95 error. Score both camera configurations with the unchanged two-view rigid observer. Original-view scores are retained as a forgetting comparison; deployment uses only opposite_obliques.

physical_gates: Only after fresh perception and FP32 export parity pass: freeze unchanged V2 R1 routing, selected V5 motor and new observer/camera sources before four-condition development. Require at least 4/6 nominal live and 4/6 pushed live; then freeze final sources before all 48 final trials. Promotion requires at least 8/12 nominal live and 8/12 pushed live, four both-nominal-pass seeds and a live advantage on their paired pushes. All refusals remain in denominators. No controller revision or relaxed physical threshold belongs to this protocol.
scope: No foundation model or new motor fitting. All V3/V4/V5 physical final scenes and the earlier camera test are excluded. Stop before the next stage if a gate fails; any follow-up needs a new protocol. Do not change the selected dinner/relay system without physical verification.
